mapper.select: select name,tax_id as taxId from company_profile order by id limit 1

select o.invoice_id as document_id,d.number,d.approval_status,d.current_node,o.supplier_id,s.name as supplier_name,o.opening_date,o.reason,i.invoice_number,i.issue_date,i.total_cents as balance_cents,d.revision from opening_payables o join invoices i on i.document_id=o.invoice_id join documents d on d.id=o.invoice_id join suppliers s on s.document_id=o.supplier_id where o.invoice_id=#{id} and d.deleted='0'

select o.invoice_id as document_id,d.number,d.approval_status,d.current_node,o.supplier_id,s.name as supplier_name,o.opening_date,o.reason,i.invoice_number,i.issue_date,i.total_cents as balance_cents,d.revision from opening_payables o join invoices i on i.document_id=o.invoice_id join documents d on d.id=o.invoice_id join suppliers s on s.document_id=o.supplier_id where d.creator_id=#{userId} and d.deleted='0' order by d.update_time desc
